create_SoftCondorcetOptimizer: create a SoftCondorcetOptimizer to find ratings by minimizing a differentiable Kendall-tau distance over a preference profile
create_FenchelYoungOptimizer: create a FenchelYoungOptimizer to optimize ratings using Fenchel-Young loss with gumbel-perturbed rankings
run_solver_optimizer: run gradient descent iterations on a preference profile to converge to optimal ratings and a ranked list
compute_ranks_ratings: compute numerical ratings and a decreasing-order ranking from voter preference data
sample_posterior_ratings: sample posterior rating distributions using preconditioned stochastic gradient descent for Bayesian inference
